{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["*"]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  release:
    types:
      - published
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: 1

jobs:
  # Always build & lint package.
  build-package:
    name: Build & verify package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - uses: hynek/build-and-inspect-python-package@67230f7b8410ae0052b39c1efc89d89fff43ff10 # v3.0.2

  # Upload to Test PyPI on every commit on main.
  release-test-pypi:
    name: Publish in-dev package to test.pypi.org
    if: |
      github.event.repository.fork == false
      && github.event_name == 'push'
      && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-package

    permissions:
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Download packages built by build-and-inspect-python-package
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: Packages
          path: dist

      - name: Upload package to Test PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 # v1.14.3
        with:
          repository-url: https://test.pypi.org/legacy/

  # Upload to real PyPI on GitHub Releases.
  release-pypi:
    name: Publish released package to pypi.org
    if: |
      github.event.repository.fork == false
      && github.event.action == 'published'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-package

    permissions:
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Download packages built by build-and-inspect-python-package
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: Packages
          path: dist

      - name: Upload package to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 # v1.14.3",
  "rationale": "The build-package job repeatedly fetches build dependencies (hatch-vcs, hatchling from pyproject.toml) on every run with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (Cache dependency downloads) is applicable: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and the cache input is the pinned lockfile/manifest (pyproject.toml). Adding a pip cache keyed on hashFiles('pyproject.toml') restores ~/.cache/pip before the build, preserving all build, test, and release steps, permissions, and triggers unchanged. This matches the measured experiment that added the same pip-cache step and reduced elapsed CI time (~9%) while keeping coverage intact. No permissions are weakened, no secrets/publishing/deployment changes are added, and no new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
